Officer's narrative
Dirver 1 was traveling through the intersection in League City, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side
by Driver 2, whose vehicle entered the intesrection from a crossing street. The point of impact and the resulting
damage to both vehicles are consistent with a side impact of this type. Driver 1 reported a knee injury at the scene
and said the knee struck the interior of the door during the collision. This account is consistent with the force and
direction of the impact as observed. Driver 2 gave a statement that matches the sequence described by Driver 1, and
two independent witnesses gave accounts that agree on the order of events. Photographs taken at the scene show
damage consistent with the reported impact, and no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to officers or noted
in the records reviewed. A passenger was present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both officers
and witnesses confirmed that Driver 1 was in the vehicle when it was struck. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on
the applicable policy.
